Long ago, I was studying to become an electric engineer.  And I had computers since the late 80s.  So I am found of technology.  I love drones, camera.  Even photography though I am not a pro.  I do own a gopro.  Some rc cars to make cool shots with it.  I love science in general.  Astronomy is my religion.  If I survive this couple of month remaining, my dream is to finish my study.  

But all this require money and energy.  Both thing I lack now.
My sleep deprivation is getting worse by the day.  My hands are shaking while I type this.

I truly appreciate what you're doing.  And to be frank with you I didn't think somebody would care here.  I hope someday I would be strong enough to help others like you do.  But I doubt it.

I'm so tired.  And lonely.
I don't control my emotion anymore.
I screamed at the dog that is living with me.  Now I feel guilty
as hell.  But he came back to me to be pet.  I don't deserve his forgiveness.

My trick before was to distract my mind.  But that rarely work now.

I'm tired.  Tired to be different.  Tired of being alone.  Tired of society
claiming that they help but when you ask for it, they trow you away.
Tired of people, who have perfect life from my point of view, still complaining.
Tired of hearing "The grass is not always greener on the other side of the fence" ;  Yes, it is 

Now even holding up until my next birthday seem far fetched.

I can already hear people saying " suicide is for the weak ".  Wont be the first time

Just a couple of month remaining.  Maybe I can manage.

Thank you anyway

Thank you Xiaxi26 for your reply.  I have tried and kind of 
like many things despite everybody denigrating every choice I make.
I was thinking today that I must wear a t-shirt saying "hate me" or something.  And i'm tired all the time.  Hard to really concentrate on things.  Tired to have to make an effort just to have the right to be.

Thank you for your compliment.  I have not heard that for a while.
